deltas.title_id: Dukung Kebijakan DHE SDA dan Ekspor Komoditas Lewat DSI, Ini Kata DJBC
deltas.title_en: PP 21/2026: 100% Foreign Exchange (DHE) Retention for Natural Resource Exporters via BUMN Banks
deltas.impact_note: PT PMA clients in natural resource extraction or commodity export must now place 100% of foreign exchange earnings (DHE) in state-owned bank devisa accounts — tightening from prior 30% retention regime. DJBC enforcing via CEISA and integrated systems.
deltas.summary: Government Regulation 21/2026 mandates that exporters of natural resource commodities (mining, agriculture, forestry) retain 100% of their foreign exchange earnings (Devisa Hasil Ekspor) in designated accounts at state-owned bank devisa (BUMN). Major tightening from the prior 30% DHE retention rule. DJBC (Directorate General of Customs) enforces compliance through CEISA and other integrated systems (SINSW, INATRADE, SiMoDIS, MOMS). PP 21/2026 was issued as part of a regulatory cluster together with PP 24/2026 and PP 26/2026 on June 13-14, 2026.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PP 21/2026 mewajibkan eksportir sumber daya alam menempatkan 100% Devisa Hasil Ekspor (DHE) ke rekening khusus di bank devisa BUMN. DJBC mendukung implementasi kebijakan ini melalui integrasi sistem CEISA, SINSW, INATRADE, SiMoDIS, dan MOMS.

deltas.title_id: PP 24/2026 Mungkinkan Pemerintah Perluas Kebijakan Ekspor Satu Pintu
deltas.title_en: PP 24/2026: Mandatory Single-Window Export Routing via PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia — Full Enforcement from January 1, 2027
deltas.impact_note: PT PMA companies in coal, palm oil, ferro alloys must already route exports through PT DSI (phased start June 1, 2026); full mandatory routing January 1, 2027. Additional commodities can be added by ministerial decree — monitor for Bali Zero clients in mining/agri export.
deltas.summary: Government Regulation 24/2026, published June 14, 2026, formalizes and expands Indonesia's mandatory single-window export policy through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI). Currently covers coal, palm oil, and ferro alloys; the regulation authorizes expansion to additional strategic commodities via ministerial decree. Exporters must route transactions through DSI and report via integrated systems. Phased implementation began June 1, 2026; full mandatory single-buyer routing effective January 1, 2027. Part of the same regulatory cluster as PP 21/2026 and PP 26/2026.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PP 24/2026 menyatakan bahwa pemerintah dapat memperluas kebijakan ekspor satu pintu melalui PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia. Implementasi bertahap mulai 1 Juni 2026 dengan kewajiban penuh berlaku 1 Januari 2027. Ekspor komoditas strategis wajib dilaporkan melalui CEISA, SINSW, INATRADE, SiMoDIS, dan MOMS.

deltas.citation: PP 20/2026 (suket transitional — Suket PPh Final lama tetap berlaku)
deltas.title_id: PP 20/2026 Terbit, Suket PPh Final Lama Tetap Berlaku
deltas.title_en: PP 20/2026: Old PPh Final UMKM Certificates (Suket) Remain Valid; 0.5% Rate Now Permanent
deltas.impact_note: UMKM/PT perorangan clients with existing Suket PPh Final under PP 55/2022 do NOT need to re-apply — certificates remain valid until eligibility ceases. Also: 0.5% PPh Final rate is now permanent (no more 3-7 year time caps under PP 55/2022).
deltas.summary: Under PP 20/2026 transitional provisions, taxpayers who previously obtained a Surat Keterangan (Suket) for PPh Final 0.5% under the old PP 55/2022 regime may continue using their existing certificate until they cease to meet eligibility criteria — no mandatory re-application. PP 20/2026 also permanently extends the 0.5% flat final income tax rate for orang pribadi and PT perorangan with gross revenue not exceeding Rp 4.8 billion per year, removing the previous 7-year (individuals) and 3-4 year (entities) time caps. Note: PP 20/2026 base regulation already in seen_citations; this article provides first clear guidance on suket transitional validity — materially new aspect.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PP 20/2026 menyatakan bahwa Surat Keterangan PPh Final yang diterbitkan berdasarkan PP 55/2022 tetap berlaku sampai WP tidak lagi memenuhi syarat. Tarif PPh Final 0,5% kini bersifat permanen bagi WP OP dan PT Perorangan dengan peredaran bruto tidak melebihi Rp 4,8 miliar per tahun pajak.

deltas.title_id: Ajukan Pencabutan Status PKP via Coretax, Ini Dokumen yang Dibutuhkan
deltas.title_en: PER-7/PJ/2025 Pasal 58: PKP Status Revocation Now via Coretax Portal
deltas.impact_note: PT PMA clients falling below PKP threshold or winding down can now initiate de-registration as PKP via Coretax (Portal Saya > Penghapusan/Pencabutan) — procedural guidance clarified June 14, 2026.
deltas.summary: Under PER-7/PJ/2025 (Pasal 58 ayat 1), taxpayers who no longer meet PKP (Pengusaha Kena Pajak) threshold can formally request revocation of PKP status through Coretax DJP via Portal Saya > Penghapusan/Pencabutan. No mandatory supporting documents specified; taxpayer coordinates with local KPP. DJP conducts administrative research before issuing final decision. Published/reported June 14, 2026.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Berdasarkan PER-7/PJ/2025 Pasal 58 ayat (1), PKP yang tidak lagi memenuhi syarat dapat mengajukan pencabutan pengukuhan PKP melalui Coretax DJP di menu Portal Saya > Penghapusan/Pencabutan. DJP akan melakukan penelitian administratif sebelum menerbitkan keputusan.
